contracts: (The boundary selector executes all operation categories and records nonzero assertions proving caller paths cannot control storage authority.) AND (The creation selector executes the real contract entrypoint and asserts a logical identity-bound result without caller-path authority.) AND (The exact SnapshotBoundaryTests selector is discovered with a nonzero case count and validates snapshot-byte aggregation; then the full PhaseA.Platform.Tests suite is run.) AND (The ordinary-edit selector is discovered and verifies no new Snapshot record or operation.) AND (The restart selector discovers and verifies a non-stale user total equal to actual stored usage.) AND (The selector executes conflicting placement inputs and verifies unchanged server ownership with a nonzero discovered test.) AND (The selector executes with a disposable Workspace fixture and observes usage equal to actual live Workspace bytes plus other user-owned usage.) AND (The selector observes user-scoped actual usage and no Project partition or reservation artifact or dependency.) AND (The selector runs with disposable roots and verifies all three IDs before and after the move.) AND (The targeted S2 selector is discovered and verifies the 30-day cleanup boundary, retained protected inputs, action auditability, and refusal of unsafe broad-prefix cleanup.) AND (The targeted selector discovers and confirms supported artifact entries and expected bytes or hashes.) AND (The targeted selector discovers and observes no temporary entries in Snapshot content or manifest inventory.) AND (The targeted selector establishes availability and unchanged content for pinned inputs after all required actions.) AND (The targeted selector executes all ownership-boundary cases with nonzero assertions and no host-path ownership authority.) AND (The targeted selector fails if deletion is omitted or run under a profile other than 30 days.) AND (The targeted selector verifies rejection and unchanged targeted resources.) AND (The write returns a quota denial and no new Workspace bytes or accepted usage are persisted.) AND (expiry 选择器被发现、执行且记录 profile 为 30 days 以及实际 expiry action。) AND (删除分支选择器被发现并执行，且读回一条标识该删除动作的审计记录。)
selector_intents: Execute the S2 retention-boundary selector against the 30-day disposable fixture and observe a behavioral failure if cleanup omits the required profile or fails to protect pinned or active-Attempt inputs.
Exercise retention cleanup with an unsafe broad path prefix and inspect rejection plus resource preservation.
Exercise the Retention_ProtectsPinnedAndActiveInputs behavior through the required actions and compare pinned inputs with their pre-action state.
Fail as a harness blocker if the required PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests selector is absent, undiscoverable, skipped, or cannot establish a nonzero test count.
PhaseA.Platform.Tests.PhaseB.SnapshotTests.OrdinaryEditDoesNotCreateSnapshot verifies ordinary edits do not enqueue or persist Snapshot work.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests calculates quota for a user with snapshots in multiple projects and fails when any snapshot's actual bytes are omitted or reserved capacity is used.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.WorkspaceIdentity_SurvivesPlacementChange_LogicalIdentity fails if workspaceId, accountId, or projectId changes after moving roots.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.WorkspaceIdentity_SurvivesPlacementChange_PlacementAuthority fails if supplied placement values alter or authorize Workspace ownership.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.WorkspaceWriteAdmission_RejectsUserQuotaOverflow
Run the Snapshot boundary selector with the mixed fixture and assert supported artifact entries and their content identity are present in retained Snapshot content and manifest inventory.
Run the Snapshot boundary selector with the mixed fixture and assert temporary entries are absent from retained content and manifest inventory.
Run the StorageOperations_UseLogicalIdentity ownership-authority selector and fail if any caller-controlled host path is accepted as the owner.
Run the creation selector and fail when creation bypasses the local storage contract, requires a caller-controlled host path, or omits logical identity binding.
Run the quota accounting selector with a known live Workspace payload and assert reported usage includes its actual byte size.
Run the quota allocation contract selector and fail if a Project-specific partition or reserved-capacity authority is observed.
Run the restart reconciliation selector with stale persisted quota totals and assert recomputation from actual Workspace and Snapshot bytes.
Run the retention selector and assert that its deletion action executes under the 30-day profile.
Run the storage-authority selector for create, read, restore, and lifecycle validation and fail if a caller path controls identity, placement, or access.
执行 Retention_ProtectsPinnedAndActiveInputs 的 expiry 分支；遗漏 expiry action 或 profile 非 30-day 时失败。
执行 Retention_ProtectsPinnedAndActiveInputs 的删除分支；删除完成后未发现关联审计记录即失败。
